ops.old: Purple sweet potato sliced paper thin and fried crisp, dusted with sea salt and togarashi, with a creamy wasabi mayo for dipping. Peel 2 purple sweet potatoes and slice paper thin on a mandoline. Soak in cold water for 20 minutes, then dry very well on tea towels. Heat 1L vegetable oil to 170C and fry in small batches for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp. Drain and toss with sea salt and a pinch of shichimi togarashi. Mix 150g mayo with 2 tsp wasabi paste and a squeeze of lime for dipping.

ops.old: Steamed edamame tossed with flaky salt, chilli and sesame oil, with cucumber batons quick-pickled in rice vinegar and sesame. Chopsticks only. Steam 400g frozen edamame in their pods for 4 minutes and toss with flaky salt, a pinch of chilli flakes and 2 tsp sesame oil. Cut a Lebanese cucumber into batons and pickle for 20 minutes in 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and a pinch of salt, then drain and scatter with toasted sesame seeds. Serve both in small bowls with chopsticks only.
